title: Wheelchair space open on both sides
why: No side is next to an obstacle, so the extra-width rule does not apply.

spec.name: Wheelchair space open on both sides

wheelchair_space_layout.hand_clearance_m.rationale: 4.2.2.2(3): 'if one side of the wheelchair is adjacent to the aisle there is no additional 50 mm requirement for that side'; with no side next to an obstacle the rule has nothing to apply to.
